pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Craft with copper ingots, copper blocks, a blast furnace, and magic ore shards. When placed, automatically forms a 2-block-tall structure.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: The Alchemy Furnace has 7 slots:$(br2)$(bold)Material Slots (left 3):$() Ingredient type and the count in each stack must match exactly. The three slots are unordered, but extra materials invalidate the recipe.$(br2)$(bold)Fuel Slot (bottom 1):$() Add any burnable item. Shift+Right-click quick-inserts fuel.$(br2)$(bold)Output Slots (right 3):$() Finished pills appear here.

pages.title: Acceleration
pages.text: $(bold)1. Alchemy Prodigy$()$(br)Enable the skill and remain near the furnace:$(br2)$(li)Normal — cooking time is halved (effective range about 5 blocks)$(li)Mastered — cooking time becomes 10% (effective range about 10 blocks)$(br2)$(bold)2. Fire Spirit Root$()$(br)A Fire-root player within about 5 blocks adds a ×0.8 cooking-time multiplier, stacking with the skill.$(br2)$(bold)3. Special Fuels$()$(br)See "Essence Charcoal & Fuels".
